notes:
- Faster charging: 100 mA instead of 50 mA (about half the time).
- The battery no longer drains while the sensor is switched off: the motion sensor is now powered down in sleep.
- Use companion app 1.0.7 or later.
- Updating from the app requires the OTAFIX bootloader: https://github.com/ODKI-tech/ODKI-VBT/blob/main/Hardware/Instructions/BOOTLOADER.md
- Known limitations: live velocity and position can be off at the start of some sets; the sensor samples at about 95 Hz.
